I hereby give notice for information of General Public that roads and paths should be adopted under no. E-06 at the Hon. General Meeting held on 12.02.2026 that roads and paths included in this Schedule should be declared as roads and paths for which an action hasn’t institute in the competent court on or before the date mentioned in the said notiﬁ cation among roads and paths deemed as belonged to Ruwanwella Pradeshiya Sabha included in the schedule of the notiﬁ cation declared in the Gazette Notiﬁ cation No. 2429/05 dated 24.03.2025 under the Order made under Section 24 of Pradeshiya Sabha Act No. 15 of 1987 in the series of Orders with regard to publishing notiﬁ cations specifying register and preparation of plans of roads and paths maintained by Pradeshiya Sabha in Sabaragamuwa province ,having been declared by Hon Governor of Sabaragamuwa Province in Extra Ordinary Gazette Notiﬁ cation No. 2316/20 dated 24th of January, 2023 .

Register regarding the said roads and paths has included in the Schedule hereto and I further notify that every road and path included therein should be deemed as roads and paths belonged to Ruwanwella Pradeshiya Sabha under Sub-section (5) of Section 24 of Pradeshiya Sabha Act.

I further notify that register with regard to the said roads and paths has been included in the Schedule hereto and every road and path included therein should be deemed as roads and paths belonged to Ruwanwella Pradeshiya Sabha under Section (5) of Section 24 of Pradeshiya Sabha Act .
Ruwanwella Pradeshiya Sabha,Ruwanwella,18th day of February, 2025.
